video_title: Who NEEDS to add Jaylen Brown? 👀 One-for-one with Jamal Murray? 🔄 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown would be the perfect second option for Denver
quotes.excerpt: The best for Jaylen Brown's career and best for a championship is sending him to Denver.
quotes.quote: The thing that makes the most sense and is best for Jaylen Brown's career and best for a championship is sending him to Denver. You get Jamal Murray over there and you have a piece of a guy who has been a second best player on a championship team in Jamal Murray. Let him play with Jason Tatum and then you bring Jaylen Brown over to Denver and let him play with Nikola Jokic. He will be the second best player on a championship contending team again.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens dropped the ball on the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: Brad Stevens completely dropped the basketball on this trade when it came down to losing the Giannis sweepstakes.
quotes.quote: I love Brad Stevens, but he completely dropped the basketball on this trade when it came down to losing the Giannis Antetokounmpo sweepstakes. Let me get that out the way. And he cannot bring Jaylen Brown back in that locker room. If I am Jaylen Brown, I do not want to be brought back in that locker room. Second time that they tried to trade this man. So let's get that out the way.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The Detroit Pistons are a logical destination for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: If you can get Jaylen Brown alongside Cade Cunningham, now you are cooking with something.
quotes.quote: I am looking at the Eastern Conference. I am looking at the Detroit Pistons. It is a lot going on because we do not know what is going to happen with Jaylen Brown. Jaylen Brown seems like he is frustrated because there is a large gap in the negotiation. If you can get Jaylen Brown alongside Cade Cunningham, now you are cooking with something. Again, right now, if I am Boston, I wait it out. I wait to see what is going to happen with Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics are unlikely to trade Jaylen Brown to a rival
quotes.excerpt: I do not think the Boston Celtics are going to deal with a team that they consider their rival.
quotes.quote: I do not think the Boston Celtics are going to deal with a team that they consider their rival. Very rarely do players like Jaylen Brown go in-conference. That is why we always look out west to a team like the Clippers, to a team like the Denver Nuggets. I do think that Jaylen Brown would be good in Detroit if they were able to find something, but I do not think the Boston Celtics are going to deal with a team that they consider their rival.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic needs a running mate of Jaylen Brown's caliber
quotes.excerpt: They need to be worried about surrounding Nikola Jokic with a player of Jaylen Brown's caliber.
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic is still quite possibly the best player on earth. He has two years left on his contract. Players do not hit free agency anymore. Free agency by all intents and purposes is dead. If you do not like your deal or you do not like where you are, you force your way out. They need to be worried about surrounding Nikola Jokic with a player of Jaylen Brown's caliber and getting creative in this way.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics are actively making calls to trade Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics are the ones actually making phone calls right now because they know they have to.
quotes.quote: They have no choice. They have to move him. And there is a reason that we are hearing reports from my guy Brian Windhorst that the Celtics are the ones actually making phone calls right now because they know they have to. Jaylen Brown is a guy that he is a different type of individual in a good way. He is not going to hold back from how he feels. We see that on his streams. We see that in the back and forth in the media.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's value is not helped by trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: You can't flatter me and say, oh, at least we tried to trade you to get Giannis.
quotes.quote: If a team or organization tried to trade me twice, and I do not give a damn, you cannot flatter me and say, oh, at least we tried to trade you to get Giannis Antetokounmpo. That does not make Jaylen Brown feel good, because in Jaylen Brown's mind, he feels like he is the best player in the NBA. He has come out and said that publicly. So trying to make him feel good by saying, look, your value was so high, we were trying to get Giannis, understand the business. No, there is no more understanding if I am Jaylen Brown.
